name: The Philadelphia Inquirer editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Philadelphia Inquirer Lean Left (-2.00; low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate AllSides or Ad Fontes rating for its editorial board was found; the board is separate from the newsroom. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/philadelphia-inquirer-media-bias.

name: Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette Center (Jan. 2022 independent review, low or initial confidence). Since May 4, 2026 it has been published by the nonprofit Venetoulis Institute, a 501(c)(3), so it does not endorse. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/pittsburgh-post-gazette-media-bias.

name: Pittsburgh Tribune-Review (TribLive) editorial board
lean_basis: Ad Fontes rates TribLive Middle (-1.04). Founded by Richard Mellon Scaife, its opinion page has a conservative history. Earlier research found it stopped endorsing candidates in 2016; that was not re-confirmed in this pass. Included so Pittsburgh readers know not to look for a pick. Rating source: https://adfontesmedia.com/trib-live-bias-and-reliability/.

name: League of Women Voters of Pennsylvania (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that says 'The League does not support or oppose any political party or candidate' (https://www.palwv.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Pennsylvania AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation with no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating, so it is labeled lean_left under this guide's rule for unions. Its About page says it is 'dedicated to represent the interests of working people' and mobilizes members 'to advocate for social and economic justice' (https://www.paaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Pennsylvania State Education Association (PSEA-PACE)
lean_basis: The state's largest teachers' union, which calls itself 'a community of education professionals who make a difference in the lives of students every day' (https://www.psea.org/about-psea/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: National Federation of Independent Business, Pennsylvania (NFIB PA PAC)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the National Federation of Independent Business Lean Right (think tank/policy group; low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is NFIB's Pennsylvania arm and its PAC. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/national-federation-independent-business-media-bias.

name: Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania
lean_basis: Environmental political group; its About page calls it 'the people-powered statewide political voice for the environment' that elects 'leaders who champion our environment' and promotes 'racially and economically just environmental policy' (https://www.conservationpa.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Pennsylvania PAC
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in Pennsylvania. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation (LifePAC)
lean_basis: Pennsylvania affiliate of the National Right to Life Committee. Its mission statement says it is 'committed to promoting the dignity and value of human life from conception to natural death and to restoring legal protection for preborn children' (https://www.paprolife.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Giffords PAC
lean_basis: Gun-safety group that says 'We’re on a mission to end gun violence' (https://giffords.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Fraternal Order of Police Lodge 5 (Philadelphia police union)
lean_basis: Philadelphia lodge of the Fraternal Order of Police (https://www.fop5.org/about). The FOP's standard description, as posted by its Georgia lodge, says it is 'committed to improving the working conditions of law enforcement officers and the safety of those we serve' (https://www.georgiafop.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Pennsylvania State Troopers Association
lean_basis: State troopers' union that says it 'supports these brave individuals by advocating for their rights, providing essential resources' (https://psta.org/), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
